thought.title: fp16 direct compute with Exp-based SiLU and chunk 256 (v2)
thought.description: Replaced fp32 intermediate computation with fp16 direct compute. Eliminated Cast half↔float per chunk (2 ops saved per N_TILE). Used Exp-based sigmoid: Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Reciprocal instead of tanh-based Muls(0.5)+Tanh+Adds(1)+Muls(0.5). Increased chunk size from 64 to 256. Switched workspace from float to half dtype. 5 TBuf buffers (was 3).
thought.reason: For memory-bound element-wise operators, fp16 direct compute eliminates Cast overhead and halves workspace UB pressure. Exp-based sigmoid has better hardware throughput on Ascend 910B than tanh-based. 256-element chunks better match the 256-wide vector unit width. Combined these produce 1.44x overall speedup (1.59x on large shapes).
thought.target_bottleneck: fp32 cast overhead and small chunk size in memory-bound element-wise kernel

runtime.dsl_before: Cast half→float. Tanh sigmoid: Muls(0.5)+Tanh+Adds(1)+Muls(0.5). Chunk=64. Workspace=float.
runtime.dsl_after: Fp16 direct compute. Exp sigmoid: Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Reciprocal+Mul+Mul. Chunk=256. Workspace=half.
